run_text_encoder_inference: run the TIPS text encoder inference CLI with a model checkpoint, tokenizer, and input text
get_text_encoder_config: get the text encoder config for a given model variant such as S, B, L, So400m, or g
load_model_weights: load numpy model weights into a PyTorch TextEncoder and strip temperature keys
tokenize_input_text: tokenize input text using the TIPS tokenizer with a maximum sequence length of 64
normalize_text_embedding: normalize the output text embedding to unit L2 norm for similarity comparison
